definitions.gloss: dome; rounded vaulted roof or building
definitions.explanation: A hemispherical roof or building with a rounded top, whether a religious structure (cathedrals, mosques), a sports stadium with a fixed or retractable roof, or a smaller covering such as a planetarium. In modern Japan, the word is most associated with large covered stadiums.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}ドーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A concert will be held at Tokyo Dome.

examples.japanese: ドーム⟦{球場|きゅうじょう}→球場：15511_kyuujou⟧なら⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If the stadium has a dome, games won't be cancelled even when it rains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広島|ひろしま}→広島：28985_hiroshima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧ドーム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}{遺産|いさん}→世界遺産：04897_sekaiisan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Atomic Bomb Dome in Hiroshima is registered as a World Heritage Site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドーム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われた→覆う：02020_oou⟧⟦{植物園|しょくぶつえん}→植物園：16479_shokubutsuen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{熱帯|ねったい}→熱帯：03531_nettai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一年中|いちねんじゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Inside the botanical garden covered by a large glass dome, tropical flowers bloom all year round.

notes:
From the English 'dome,' which itself comes from Latin {domus} ('house'). Adopted into Japanese in the modern era and now firmly established for both architectural domes and modern domed stadiums.

USAGE:
- Most often appears as part of stadium names: {東京|とうきょう}ドーム, ナゴヤドーム, ⟦{福岡|ふくおか}→福岡：30729_fukuoka⟧ドーム, {京|きょう}セラドーム. The phrase 'a Tokyo Dome's worth' ({東京|とうきょう}ドーム{何個分|なんこぶん}) is even used as a casual unit of size in Japanese media.
- ドーム⟦{球場|きゅうじょう}→球場：15511_kyuujou⟧ ('domed stadium') and ドーム{型|がた} ('dome-shaped, dome-type') are common compound forms.
- ⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧ドーム ('Atomic Bomb Dome') is the well-known landmark in Hiroshima.
- For small dome-shaped covers in product names — bento containers, cake covers — ドーム{型|がた} is typical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東京|とうきょう}ドーム: Tokyo Dome
- ドーム⟦{球場|きゅうじょう}→球場：15511_kyuujou⟧: domed stadium
- ドーム{型|がた}: dome-shaped; dome-type
- ⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧ドーム: the Atomic Bomb Dome (Hiroshima)
- ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドーム: a glass dome
- ドーム⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧: dome roof
- プラネタリウム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドーム: the planetarium dome

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {丸|まる}{屋根|やね}: round/dome roof — the native equivalent; less common in modern usage; mostly literary or technical.
- ⟦{球場|きゅうじょう}→球場：15511_kyuujou⟧: ballpark; baseball stadium — refers to the stadium itself, not specifically domed.
- ⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧: gymnasium; sports hall — an enclosed sports facility, but typically without a dome roof.
- ⟦アリーナ→アリーナ：10708_ariina⟧: arena — another loanword; an indoor performance/sports venue, often without a literal dome.
